name: Disable Memory Compression
description: Disables Windows memory compression to reduce CPU overhead during paging, which may increase RAM usage.

description_i18n.en: Disables Windows memory compression to reduce CPU overhead during paging, which may increase RAM usage.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die Speicherkomprimierung in Windows, um den CPU-Overhead beim Auslagern zu verringern; dies kann mehr Arbeitsspeicher verbrauchen.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive la compression de mémoire dans Windows pour réduire le surcoût du processeur lors de l'échange de pages ; cela peut augmenter l'utilisation de la RAM.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: The tweak uses the Windows MMAgent API to control memory compression. If SysMain is disabled, memory compression is already inactive and Nova Tweaks leaves the service configuration unchanged.
